notes.title: Patch Notes 1.1.5
notes.notes:
Fixed bug with Twirt in Tavern:
For everybody who already found this bug - quest will become completed and reward gained automatically. For new game quest will work as it have to. 

GUI Scale with 4K support:
Now users with screen resolution 1920x1080 and higher can find special parameter "GUI Scale" in Settings->Video. Available scale values depends on your resolution and can be one of x1, x1.2, x1.5, x2, x2.4. Warning! GUI created for x1 scale, so dependent on you monitor size, resolution and selected scale, GUI can loose it's sharpness end become tiny blurry.

Thank you for the feedback and stay tuned! ːwnk_arthurː

notes.title: Update 1.1.4 - Arena and Christmas sale!

Ho-Ho-Ho, dear friends! We prepared for you two large Christmas presents.

notes.title: Hooray! Patch 1.1.2 arrived!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28195285/95b6c38bb2de43d21990e91fa830cdfcfde60d4b.png
Dear gamers! We are thankful for your support and feedback. As promised, we are continue to work on the game even after full release, and current update is the best prove of this. ːsteamhappyː

New shop - main development of this update:

 Shop interface fully redesigned to be more user-friendly.
 Added possibility to change team member, on whose behalf you would look through the shop, right in the shop window.
 Added tabs to filter shop and inventory items.
 Fixed ingredients cost, Исправлена стоимость некоторых ингредиентов, that earlier made unfavourable and useless craft system.


Gameplay fixes:

 Added possibility to change difficulty level right in the game from settings menu (tab "Others").
 Fixed loot spawning in unreachable points.
 Added automatic healing for all team members after win in combat.
 Team members and enemies no more collect theirs Action Points while under Stun, Freeze or Chain effects.


Fixed characters Skills:

 Fixed life healing for Guinevere if somewho from your team members was attacked and Guinevere has the "Word of Life" skill.
 Fixed Action Points recovery by Kerdik after use the "Ruin" skill.
 Fixed Action Points recovery by Idril after use the "Rapid Fire" skill.


Localization fixes:

 Names for some Skills and Bufs/DeBuffs.
 Added information about chance to Stun when using Guinevere's "Lightning Strike" skill.
 Fixed description for Strength stat. "Increase physical armor" changed to "Increase Initiative".
 Other minor fixed for localization issues.


In the next update we will update Pathfinding and navigation system, characters AI, tiny more improve game balance and a little more, so you can take even more enjoy from Willy-Nilly Knight game. ːwnk_arthurː

We must also pay special tribute to our most active gamers:

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.7
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28195285/c18ac39151139b1625459f5e7282b1112744d2fe.png
In this patch we changed a lot of key mechanics of the game.

Changes in battle system:
Now all your damage have one of the following modificators: piercing, crushing, slashing, ice, fire, electricity, poison, holy and dark. This changes gave us an ability to increase role of the immunes. Furthermore, now damage type can be more efficient on some mobs then the other one.

Weapon requirements:
From now some skills require exact type of weapon equipped. And of course they change power based on weapon power.

Weapons visualization:
Equipped weapons now changes not only inventory icon, but 3D model in the character's hands too. This applies to all weapons, except bows, they will be ready in next updates.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28195285/fd3c2d4825c5a1bc778d7b973e7937227dcae2e9.png

New equipment type - shields:
Now Arthur can carry shield in the left hand. Shield gave him additional defense. In next updates we will change their mechanic and make it deeper and interesting.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28195285/d4b2d3aa855943468ff357870d29fa2f37fb83d1.png

Changes in tooltips:
Information about skills and items now shows in more beauty and readable way. In additions now you can see final attack damage and modifier from skills and items (counted on single base, without enemy defenses and immunes).

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28195285/c86499ff32373ccdd6d1d21669214135c665747f.png

This is the first, but very large and important part of changes in game mechanics and visualization. As ever We will proactively track and correct any bugs that appear. Thank you in advance for your understanding. Stay with us and share your opinion, together we «Make the tactical RPG great again!». ːwnk_shieldːːwnk_swordː

notes.title: The release of Willy-Nilly Knight RPG will be held this fall!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28195285/fe379b30c09ddb0ef0618ff937d691171fe18d69.png
Friends, Double Dice Game Studio is pleased to announce that the developers (wrapped up in warm blankets and in positive mood) are working hard on the game and has almost achieved its ideal quality. Thanks to your support,  our warm and cozy game will be in full-fledged release this fall.

Special thanks goes to those of you, who didn’t fail to spend their time and energy and helped us with the game during its early access, taking part in testing and improving WNK. Only because of the early access period we were able to improve the game to its final quality and to show the world the dream project that we’d planned.

Here's a short list of a small part of the changes that will appear in the game:

 The new combat system is more convenient, more profound, developed with the help of our players;
 The ability to split the game -  better tactical component with the optimal positioning of team members during the battle:
 Changing of the weapon models - each sword, bow, staff, ax and hammer will have their own unique image when equipping the character.
 Modifiers of damage and immunity - stabbing, crushing, fiery. Now immune to various modifications of the damage has a very important role, for example, attacking skeletons with fire skills is less efficient than doing it with crushing skills.
 Partial support for gamepads - the exact degree of support will be clearer to the release date.
 More interactive objects in the game (boxes, barrels, chests, etc.) with loot!


By far there’s more to it! We are sure you will be pleasantly surprised by the new, high-quality and interesting game of Willy-Nilly Knight!

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.5
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28195285/e9015b02aef4f5de8e95ac6078d07d590dd7181e.png
We've prepared a number of nice changes in this update. One of the most important key points is the new crafting system. Many users have complained that the old crafting system wasn't transparent, so players just didn't understand how to use it. We've tried to make the new system easier to understand and use. We've also added notifications about new Journal entries and new locations on the Global Map.

New functionality in the current patch:

New Craft system.
Notifications about new Journal entries.
Notifications about new locations on the Global Map.
Added HP information on selected enemies.


Critical fixes in the current patch:

Skills cannot be used if a character does not have the right weapon equipped.
Fixed bug, when unreachable enemies or interactive items was able to interact instantly from the place.


Attention! We've collected a large amount of feedback from you and begun a global rethinking and reworking of certain game mechanics. This applies primarily to the the combat system. Because of this it is possible that you may, on very rare occasions, encounter bugs in the game that cause the game client to crash. We will proactively track and correct any bugs that appear. Thank you in advance for your understanding. Stay with us and share your opinion, together we «Make the tactical RPG great again!». ːwnk_shieldːːwnk_swordː
